name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap with Grape Tomatoes

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.

Peel and mince garlic. Grate 3 tsp of lemon zest. In a medium bowl, prepare marinade by whisking together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the dressing), lemon zest and juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
zest and juice from 1 ½ lemon
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add to marinade and toss to coat.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash and dry lettuce. Halve lengthwise, then hop crosswise into 2 ½ cm strips. Transfer to a large bowl.
Grate ⅓ cup of Parmesan. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, Parmesan, lemon juice, yogurt, olive oil, Dijon, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
42 g Parmesan cheese
juice of ¾ lemon
⅜ cup plain Greek yogurt
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp Worcestershire sauce
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pour dressing into bowl with lettuce and toss to coat.

Place tortillas on a flat surface, add lettuce to the middle, and top with chicken. Tightly roll to close. Place on the grill/skillet seam side down and toast until golden brown, 1-2 minutes per side.
Slice remaining lemon into wedges. Wash tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lemon
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place chicken wraps on a plate, add tomatoes on the side, and garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!
